name: Trade documents inconsistent with each other
description: Bill of lading, invoice, customs, letter of credit or payment details disagree on goods, quantity, price, origin, parties or route.
fp: Clerical errors or HS-code variations occur.

links.name: Species or origin descriptions inconsistent across documents
links.ctx: Shipping, customs and invoices mention different species, origin or volumes.

links.name: Shipping documents inconsistent with goods or route
links.ctx: Dates, weights, ports or vessel details do not align.

links.name: Goods description vague or inconsistent across documents
links.ctx: Bill of lading, invoice and letter of credit describe quantity, goods or parties differently.

links.name: Inconsistent origin and destination across documents
links.ctx: Certificate of origin, invoice and shipping data disagree on country of origin or consignee.

links.name: Discrepancies between invoice, shipment and payment details
links.ctx: Quantity, price, consignee or route differs across documents in commodity transactions.
